description: Second-broker drill — shorter first-turn add_car tone vs default industry template.

add_car.zh: 可加车核价。请发：年份、车型、提车日、地址邮编、主要驾驶人；有 VIN 请一并提供。本所收齐后于营业日内处理。
add_car.en: We can price the add. Send year, make/model, delivery date, zip, main driver; VIN if available. Our desk will process on business days.

missing_document.zh_with_item: 尚缺 {item_text}。请补发；若已发送请说明渠道与时间，本所核对后于营业日内推进。
missing_document.zh_without_item: 尚有资料缺口。请补发；若已发送请说明，本所核对后于营业日内推进。
missing_document.zh_already_sent_with_item: 已知悉您已发送。请附完整通知与 {item_text}，本所核对后于营业日内回复。
missing_document.zh_already_sent_without_item: 已知悉您已发送。请附完整通知与已发材料截图或说明，本所核对后于营业日内回复。
missing_document.en_with_item: Still need {item_text}. Please resend; if already sent, note when/how so we can verify on the next business day.
missing_document.en_without_item: Still need a document. Please resend; if already sent, tell us how so we can verify on the next business day.
missing_document.en_already_sent_with_item: Understood. Send the full notice and {item_text} for verification; we will reply on a business-day basis.
missing_document.en_already_sent_without_item: Understood. Send the full notice and what you sent; we will verify on a business-day basis.

missing_signature.zh: 文件仍有签名缺口。请把需签页发来，本所先核对具体签署栏位并于营业日内回复。
missing_signature.en: A signature item is still missing. Send the flagged page and our desk will verify the exact signature line on a business-day basis.

underwriting_followup.zh: 核保端仍需补件。请发通知要求的内容，本所整理后于营业日内补交并回覆进度。
underwriting_followup.en: Underwriting still needs additional items. Send what the notice requests and our desk will package and resubmit on a business-day basis.

renewal_reminder.zh: 这属于续保提醒，当前通常无需额外操作。到方案确认窗口时，本所会在营业日内联系您。
renewal_reminder.en: This is a renewal reminder and usually needs no action now. Our desk will contact you on a business-day basis when plan review is due.

informational.zh: 目前看属信息通知，暂不需额外处理；如有新变动，本所会在营业日内同步。
informational.en: This appears informational for now, so no extra action is needed. If anything changes, our desk will update you on a business-day basis.

add_driver.zh: 可加司机。请说明车辆、驾驶人身份与驾照信息，本所将于营业日内确认下一步。
add_driver.en: We can add a driver. Send vehicle, driver details, and license; our desk will confirm next steps on a business-day basis.

bundling.zh: 房屋险与车险合并投保通常有优惠。请把您现有车险与房屋险（如有）情况发来，本所帮您查看可行方案。
bundling.en: Bundling home and auto often saves premium. Send your current auto and home policy basics and our desk will check options.
